newsitem.title: USA: P-Com Inc to acquire Columbia Spectrum.
newsitem.headline: P-Com Inc to acquire Columbia Spectrum.

text.p: P-Com Inc said on Wednnesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Columbia Spectrum Management LP.

P-Com said in a statement that it will pay $22.5 million, comprised of $8.0 million in cash and $14.5 million of P-Com's common stock. The acquisition, expected to close in February, will be accounted for under the purchase method of accounting and it is not expected to have a material adverse effect on 1997 financial results.

Columbia provides turnkey relocation services for microwave paths for Personal Communications Services and other emerging technologies. P-Com is a maker of millimeter wave radio systems for the worldwide wireless telecommunications market.
